tags: Hidden Door Hinge for 1 Inch Thick Doors
DEL-DCH208 2-3/4 Inch x 5/8 Inch Invisible Hinges

text.description_html:
Deltana DCH208 Hidden Door Hinges for 1" Thick Doors

The 2-3/4 Inch x 5/8 Inch Invisible Hinge is most often used doors where a clean look is desired. When the door is closed, Deltana's DCH208 Invisible Hinge cannot be seen or tampered with. When opened, the riveted hinge pin is non-removable. The installed hinge is firmly anchored in a deep, full mortise, which assists the screws in supporting the door, assuring a stronger door hinge installation. Package includes a pair of hinges (2 hinges).

For use on 1" Thick Doors

Also Available:
1-3/8" Thick Door Hidden Hinge and 1-3/4" Thick Door Hidden Hinge
Steel Invisible Door Hinge for 1" Thick Doors

Specifications of the Invisible Door Hinges:

  • Overall Height: 2-3/4"
  • Height center to center: 2"
  • Leaf Width: 5/8"
  • Knuckle Height: 3/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1"
  • Hinge Material: Pressure cast zinc housing and 304 Stainless Steel links
  • Deltana DCH208 Hinge Specifications (PDF)

*Sold in Pairs (2 Hinges)
